subject: Clarify CCI line-item / token breakdown on Dec invoice + VAT classification
messages:
From: Alex Gordon <alex@clearcore.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance AP <ap@clearcore.ai>
Date: Fri, 8 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Question on CCI line item + VAT on Dec invoice

Hi Vanessa,

Hope you had a good holiday. We just received the Dec invoice (attached) and see two CCI line items that combined represent ~48% of the token charge. Our platform doesn't appear to have generated that volume. Can you help us understand: 

- What "CCI" stands for on the invoice (we assume some cross-customer ingestion or collection charge, but need a precise definition).
- A per-model and per-endpoint token breakdown for the billed period (Dec 1-31).
- Whether these CCI tokens are generated by a Redwood-managed background job (e.g., ingestion, embeddings rebuild), or if they're attributable to our API keys/sessions.
- How these items are classified for VAT purposes (digital service vs. platform usage).

I've attached the invoice PDF and our internal usage export for Dec. We're on a monthly consumption invoice (DL-19452). If this is an error, please prioritize — we'll put the payment on hold until we have a reconciliation.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Gordon
Head of Engineering | ClearCore Analytics

Hi Alex — thanks for sending this over and for flagging. Really sorry for the surprise.

Short answer up front: CCI on the invoice refers to "Cross-Customer Ingest" operations (internal shorthand) — automated reindexing/embedding rebuild jobs we run for a small set of models. It should not be charged to customers without explicit consent; I agree this needs immediate review.

Next steps from our side:
1) Rafael (billing) — can you pull the token-level export and a mapping that ties invoice line items to request IDs for ClearCore (Dec 1-31)? Alex sent their usage export; we'll cross-check.
2) Marissa (account ops) — can you open a provisional credit request and hold collection for invoice #1124 until we reconcile?
3) Alex — can you confirm whether you gave us consent for any managed ingestion/embedding rebuild in Q4? If not, we'll escalate.

I'll follow up with Rafael by EOD. Apologies again for the disruption.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

(Referenced attachments retained)
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Gordon <alex@clearcore.ai>
Date: Fri, 8 Jan 2027 12:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Question on CCI line item + VAT on Dec invoice

Vanessa, Alex,

Thanks — I've pulled the meter and correlated the invoice line items to request logs. Summary so far: 

- The two CCI line items map to background embedding rebuild jobs initiated on Dec 18 and Dec 24 (job ids: EMB-77821, EMB-78005).
- Those jobs ran on a shared internal ingestion queue. By policy, we tag any non-customer-initiated internal maintenance as internal cost — it should not generate a customer-facing CCI charge.
- In ClearCore's case, a mis-tagging bug (fixed 2027-01-02) caused those runs to get attributed to customer token counts. We have the full request ID list and a per-request token count CSV attached (redwood_metering_sample_slice_Q4-2026.csv).

VAT classification: our tax team classifies model inference and tokenized generation as a digital service subject to VAT in most EU jurisdictions. That said, because these runs were internal maintenance, we will remove the token charges and treat any tax previously calculated on them as void — effectively a full reversal of the tax on those CCI line items. We'll provide an updated invoice and adjusted VAT summary.

Immediate remediation plan: 
- Remove the two CCI line items and reissue invoice #1124 within 48 business hours.
- Issue a provisional credit for the full amount while we re-run the billing calculation.
- Provide ClearCore with: (a) per-request token CSV, (b) a short incident note explaining root cause and fix, (c) the revised invoice + VAT recalculation.

Attaching: redwood_metering_sample_slice_Q4-2026.csv (contains request_id, model, endpoint, tokens).

Rafael
Director, Billing & Payments | Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: redwood_metering_sample_slice_Q4-2026.csv (text/csv)

- The corrected invoice and VAT breakdown by EOD Monday (1/11).
- A short incident report summarizing root cause and fix.

Can you confirm whether you prefer us to: (A) reissue the corrected invoice and let you proceed with payment now, or (B) hold payment until you receive the rewritten invoice? We will not proceed with collections in the interim.

Thanks for your patience — we know invoice holds are disruptive.

Best,
Vanessa

Vanessa, Rafael — appreciate the speedy triage and the transparency. ClearCore prefers option (A): reissue the corrected invoice and we'll schedule payment once the updated VAT summary is attached. Finance AP will wait for the revised document and the provisional credit entry before releasing funds.

Two requests to close the loop: 
1) Please include a one-line statement on the corrected invoice that the removed CCI items were internal maintenance and are not billable to ClearCore. We need that for our audit trail.
2) Can you confirm whether this bug affected any other customers in Dec? If yes, please provide an outreach plan.

If you can confirm both items in the corrected package, we'll clear payment within 3 business days of receiving it.

Thanks,
Alex
